title: I Still Love You
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

successful_carousel_standard.rule: Build a public identity mirror with concrete couple receipts, active Zuv care, an emotional reversal, and a send/save thesis; stage the story in visible actions before choosing poster text; do not optimize for keywords.
successful_carousel_standard.open_reasoning_policy: Expose the real goal and selection logic; do not optimize for keywords or let slide copy substitute for staged story action.
successful_carousel_standard.prompt_rule: Prompts must prove relationship behavior through stage-scene Aachu/Zuv action; text completes the scene instead of carrying it.

human_truth: Lasting love is not the absence of disagreement; it is the repeated choice to stay tender, repair, and imagine the two of you still side by side after every bad day.
emotional_arc: disagreement hook -> fight/repair proof -> handhold bridge -> older-couple witness -> bad-day cost -> future-us certainty -> still-choosing thesis
source_story_summary:
We disagree, I still love you.
We fight, I still love you.
You know why?
Because every time I see an older couple, standing side by side, I think about everything it took to get there.
All the arguments. All the bad days. All the times they could’ve walked away, but didn’t.
And then I think of us. Because I know that’s going to be us one day.
Still together. Still choosing each other. Still completely in love.
Caption: I know we’re going to make it all the way ♾️
visual_style: Create a premium hand-drawn romantic watercolor-and-ink @a.storyof.two Instagram post illustration in native 4:5 portrait composition when the requested surface is Instagram post, and generate separate native 9:16 artwork for Reels/Stories when needed. Always use config/references/a-story-illustration-master-prompt.md, config/references/a-story-premium-illustration-style-lock.md, and the style bundle in config/references/style-lock/observational-intimacy-premium/. Use shared images only as mood/composition references unless the creator explicitly says otherwise; preserve their emotional essence, copy, message, story, gesture, objects, and requested composition, but never let an external reference style take over. Use the Aachu/Zuv identity reference as the face and wardrobe anchor always. Identity reference images are the highest-priority face source: preserve the same recurring real-person Aachu/Zuv faces, expressions, warm medium-brown South Asian skin tones, Aachu's expressive dark eyes and long dark wavy hair, and Zuv's curly dark hair, strong brows, dark almond eyes, defined nose, short natural stubble, and gentle smile. Previous successful illustrations are style references only: use them for warm ivory paper, visible paper grain, fine ink and pencil linework, transparent watercolor blooms, delicate sketch texture, muted vintage palette, tactile clothing detail, soft faded edges, lower/middle-lower couple placement, and generous clean upper-middle negative space. Render exact handwritten text in upper-middle negative space, matching the approved handwritten font styles from the reference images. Every final illustration must include only the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' in the bottom-right as part of the paper artwork. No photorealism, no UI, no random text, no quote-card design. Scene logic and pose anatomy are hard gates: clothing, props, and body action must prove the exact copy, and both people must look natural, flattering, and physically believable.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

carousel_story_director_persona.source_story:
We disagree, I still love you.
We fight, I still love you.
You know why?
Because every time I see an older couple, standing side by side, I think about everything it took to get there.
All the arguments. All the bad days. All the times they could’ve walked away, but didn’t.
And then I think of us. Because I know that’s going to be us one day.
Still together. Still choosing each other. Still completely in love.
Caption: I know we’re going to make it all the way ♾️

candidates.tender_thesis: Love is the person who still stands beside you.
